card.title: Director, Operations & Quality Compliance
card.description:
**Summary**

We are seeking a Director, Global Safety Operations & Quality Management to provide strategic, operational, and technical leadership across Immunic's PV operations, quality management, compliance, and inspection readiness activities for our development and post-marketing portfolio, reporting to the VP of Pharmacovigilance & Patient Safety as a key member of the Global PV leadership team. You will oversee global safety reporting, ICSR processing, aggregate reporting, safety surveillance, quality management systems, compliance, and inspection readiness, ensuring PV activities are governed, risk-based, and scalable, while providing executive-level oversight of CROs, vendors, and external service providers to ensure governance, performance management, and continuous improvement of outsourced PV activities.This is a highly collaborative and strategic role, where you must operate effectively in an evolving biotech to translate regulatory and business requirements into practical operating models, and build high-performing teams and sustainable PV capabilities.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement pharmacovigilance processes, policies, SOPs, and safety database/PV systems.
* Lead cross-functional governance, benefit-risk assessment, signal detection, and risk management efforts.
* Chair the executive safety review committee, oversee safety data exchange with partners, and contribute to industry-wide safety initiatives.
* Partner with clinical development to integrate safety into protocols, risk management plans, and safety charters.
* Provide PV oversight for regulatory filings (IND/BLA/MAA) - including Clinical Overviews, ISS, and RMPs - and review IBs, DSURs, and key CSR sections; participate in regulatory meetings as needed.
* Lead medical review of ICSRs and oversee PV team operations, quality, and compliance with global safety regulations.
* Monitor and assess CRO performance on pharmacovigilance activities.
* Recruit, hire, train, mentor, and coach PV staff, and oversee project deliverables and performance evaluations.

**Qualifications & Education**

* Healthcare professional (RN, PharmD, MD) with clinical and industry experience and a proven track record leading pharmacovigilance teams.
* Minimum of 15 years' experience in drug safety and pharmacovigilance roles in the biotech or pharmaceutical industry.
* Proven leadership expertise, including a track record of building and leading high-performing teams.
* In-depth knowledge of global pharmacovigilance regulations and compliance requirements (EMA/FDA/ICH).
* Strong leadership and strategic decision-making abilities to drive safety initiatives and ensure regulatory compliance.

Immunic Therapeutics is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status.

**Please note, Immunic does not accept unsolicited resumes from external agencies or recruiters. Submission of a resume without a prior written agreement does not create any express or implied contract between Immunic and the agency. Immunic will not pay any fees related to unsolicited resumes.**

Compensation Range: $220K - $260K

card.title: Director of Quality and Survey
card.description:
At Vetter Senior Living, our mission is simple: **Dignity in Life**. We are a premier provider of long-term care, assisted living, independent living, therapy, and home health and hospice services, and our team of skilled and caring people is committed to making quality service a way of life. Our work is guided by our values of Serving, Integrity, Teamwork, and Excellence.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Director of Quality and Survey to provide quality and survey leadership and support to our communities. Through strong personal relationships, you will help our communities and service lines ensure that quality and regulatory requirements are not only met but exceeded. This role travels between communities and serves as a trusted clinical and regulatory resource for facility leadership.

### **Benefits**

* Student Loan Repayment Assistance
* Earned Wage Access
* Medical Insurance Options
* Vision Coverage
* Free Individual Dental Insurance
* 401(k) with Employer Match
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Employee Assistance Program
* Leadership Development Opportunities
* Career Growth and Advancement
* Supportive Senior Leadership Team
* Great Place to Work® Certified Organization

**What You Will Do**

* Monitor compliance with federal and state regulations and maintain ongoing survey readiness in skilled nursing and assisted living.
* Identify potential deficiencies early and help facility leadership develop corrective actions.
* Conduct focused and routine audits of high-risk areas such as falls, wounds, infections, medication management, hospital transfers, documentation, and changes in condition.
* Manage the iQIES and HARP systems for the organization.
* Support facility Quality Assurance and Performance Improvement (QAPI) activities by identifying trends, establishing improvement plans, monitoring results, and evaluating whether interventions are working.
* Provide targeted education and coaching to Directors of Nursing, nurse leaders, and clinical teams when audits or quality data reveal knowledge or process gaps.
* Drive corrective actions such as staff education, coaching, focused chart reviews, and process changes.
* Serve as a clinical and regulatory resource to facility leadership on complex compliance, resident-care, documentation, or risk concerns.
* Partner with leadership while maintaining facility accountability for day-to-day operations.
* Promote continuous improvement in quality and survey processes and outcomes, and support all Vetter Senior Living service lines and growth opportunities.

**What You Bring**

* Licensed nurse (RN preferred).
Minimum of 3* -5 years of experience in post-acute care.
* Experience managing quality outcomes, with a strong understanding of regulations and survey preparation and management.
* Excellent communication and education skills.
* Strong organizational and relationship-building skills.
* Ability and willingness to travel between communities.
* High personal integrity, a caring attitude, and a genuine desire to work with and support others.

**Why Join Us**

You will be part of a highly respected team of skilled and caring people who are committed to making quality service a way of life. Your daily efforts will help our communities deliver exceptional care, and you will find fulfillment in building relationships, coordinating care, and helping enhance the dignity in people's lives.

**Ready to make a difference? Apply today to join the Vetter Senior Living team.**

card.title: Sr. Director of Quality
card.description:
The Senior Director of Quality is responsible for leading quality, regulatory compliance, and functions at an assigned facility while providing strategic leadership, guidance, and support to Quality departments across multiple FCAH locations and operating companies. This role ensures compliance with applicable FAA, EASA, customer, and industry requirements while driving consistency in quality standards, processes, audit readiness, corrective actions, and continuous improvement throughout the organization.

The Senior Director serves as a hands-on quality leader at their assigned location while partnering with site leadership and other Quality leaders to strengthen quality systems, address regulatory and operational risks, develop quality teams, and promote a culture of accountability, safety, and excellence across the organization.

**Essential Job Functions:**

**Site Quality Leadership**

* Lead and manage the Quality department at the assigned facility, ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory, customer, and company requirements.
* Partner with site leadership, Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Supply Chain, and other departments to integrate quality into daily operations and decision-making.
* Oversee site quality personnel, including staffing, performance management, training, development, and accountability.
* Ensure the facility maintains required certifications, approvals, manuals, procedures, and quality systems.
* Monitor site quality performance, identify areas of risk, and develop action plans to address deficiencies and improve operational performance.

**Multi-Site Quality Leadership & Support**

* Provide leadership, guidance, and support to Quality departments and leaders across other First Class Air operating companies and locations.
* Partner with site Quality leaders to identify challenges, strengthen quality processes, and improve regulatory compliance and operational effectiveness.
* Promote consistency in quality standards, processes, procedures, and best practices across locations where appropriate.
* Assist other locations with quality initiatives, regulatory concerns, audit preparation, corrective actions, customer issues, and process improvement efforts.
* Conduct site visits to evaluate quality systems, identify opportunities for improvement, and provide support to local Quality teams.
* Share lessons learned, recurring quality issues, and best practices across locations to prevent repeat findings and improve overall organizational performance.
* Help develop and implement company-wide quality initiatives while allowing for site-specific requirements, certifications, and regulatory differences.
* Escalate significant regulatory, operational, customer, or quality risks to executive leadership.

**Regulatory Compliance & Oversight**

* Ensure compliance with applicable FAA, EASA, UK CAA, , customer, and other regulatory requirements, as applicable to company operations.
* Maintain strong working knowledge of FAA regulations, including Part 145, Part 43, and Part 21, as applicable.
* Serve as a point of contact for regulatory authorities, customer representatives, and external auditors, as appropriate.
* Monitor regulatory changes and ensure applicable requirements are communicated and implemented across affected locations.
* Ensure maintenance, repair, overhaul, inspection, manufacturing, and other applicable activities are performed in accordance with approved technical data, regulatory requirements, and established procedures.
* Maintain organizational readiness for regulatory, customer, and third-party audits.

**Quality Management Systems**

* Develop, implement, maintain, and continuously improve Quality Management Systems (QMS) at the assigned location and across other locations as needed.
* Establish and promote consistent quality standards, policies, procedures, and best practices across the organization.
* Oversee the development, revision, and implementation of quality manuals, procedures, inspection programs, and supporting documentation.
* Ensure appropriate document control, records management, inspection processes, calibration programs, personnel qualifications, training, and other critical quality system controls are maintained.
* Partner with site and enterprise leadership to improve quality processes, reduce risk, and enhance operational performance.

**Audits, Corrective Actions & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead and oversee internal, external, regulatory, customer, and third-party audits at the assigned facility.
* Support and provide guidance to other locations in preparation for and execution of audits.
* Develop and support risk-based audit schedules and audit strategies.
* Ensure audit findings and quality issues are appropriately investigated, contained, corrected, and documented.
* Oversee corrective and preventive action (CAPA) processes and ensure root cause analysis is appropriately performed.
* Verify corrective actions are effective and prevent recurring issues.
* Identify recurring findings, systemic quality issues, and trends across locations and implement improvements where appropriate.

**Airworthiness & Technical Quality**

* Provide oversight of airworthiness and return-to-service processes across applicable repair station operations.
* Ensure appropriate controls are maintained for FAA Form 8130-3, EASA Form 1, inspection, certification, and related airworthiness documentation, as applicable.
* Ensure receiving, in-process, and final inspections are performed in accordance with applicable procedures and requirements.
* Oversee the management and control of capability lists, personnel authorizations, technician and inspector qualifications, stamps, and related records.
* Ensure calibration programs and control of tools, equipment, and test instruments meet applicable requirements.
* Assist other locations with technical quality concerns, inspection processes, airworthiness issues, and regulatory interpretations as needed.

**Customer & Supplier Quality**

* Provide leadership and support in resolving significant customer quality concerns, escalations, and recurring issues.
* Partner with Sales, Operations, Maintenance, and other departments to ensure customer quality expectations are understood and met.
* Monitor supplier-related quality trends and recurring issues.
* Support supplier corrective actions, quality investigations, and improvement initiatives as needed.
* Serve as a quality escalation resource for customer and supplier issues across locations.

**Quality Performance, Reporting & Risk Management**

* Establish and monitor quality performance metrics, KPIs, trends, and reporting processes for the assigned facility.
* Support the development and implementation of company-wide quality dashboards and performance metrics.
* Evaluate quality data to identify trends, recurring issues, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Communicate significant quality concerns, regulatory risks, audit findings, and improvement initiatives to site leadership and executive leadership.
* Partner with leadership to prioritize quality initiatives and allocate resources appropriately.
* Provide visibility into quality performance across locations and recommend actions to improve overall company performance.

**Requirements:**

* Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in aviation, aerospace, MRO, manufacturing, or another highly regulated environment.
* Minimum of 7 years of progressive leadership experience in Quality, Regulatory Compliance,, Inspection, or related functions preferred.
* Significant experience leading Quality functions within aviation maintenance, repair, overhaul, manufacturing, or FAA-certified repair station environments.
* Experience supporting multiple departments, facilities, locations, or business units.
* Experience working directly with FAA, EASA, UK CAA, customer representatives, or other regulatory authorities preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading regulatory, customer, internal, and external audits.
* Experience developing, implementing, and maintaining Quality Management Systems.
* Strong working knowledge of FAA regulations, particularly Part 145, Part 43, and Part 21, as applicable.
* Knowledge of EASA, UK CAA,, and other applicable regulatory requirements preferred.
* Strong understanding of Quality Management Systems (QMS), corrective and preventive action (CAPA), root cause analysis, risk management, audit processes, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to interpret technical data, regulatory requirements, manuals, procedures, engineering documentation, and quality standards.
* This role will require 20%-30% travel to other facilities

card.description:
### **Position Summary**

The Director of Healthcare Operations provides strategic and operational leadership across a portfolio of skilled nursing facilities (SNFs). This role is accountable for clinical quality, regulatory compliance, financial performance, and resident and family satisfaction. The Director partners with facility administrators, directors of nursing, and Home Office leadership to drive consistent standards, develop leaders, and sustain survey readiness, while keeping resident-centered care at the center of every decision.

### **Our Core Values in This Role**

* **Human First:** Lead with compassion and respect, putting people first, whether residents, families, or teammates, and build an environment where everyone feels valued, supported, and encouraged to grow.
* **Keeping the Tempo:** Maintain a steady, focused rhythm across all facilities, empowering individual initiative and driving consistent, purposeful execution of the practices that help us meet and exceed our goals.
* **Curiously Driven:** Never settle for the status quo; pursue continuous improvement, treat mistakes as opportunities to learn and grow, and challenge boundaries in pursuit of excellence in care and operations.
* **Do the Right Thing:** Act with integrity and accountability, even when no one is watching, earning the trust of residents, families, and teammates by honoring commitments and standing behind every decision.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Operational Leadership**

* Oversee day-to-day operations across assigned facilities, ensuring consistent execution of company policies, procedures, and standards of care
* Coach, develop, and evaluate facility administrators and department leaders, including recruitment and succession planning
* Conduct regular on-site visits, operational audits, and performance reviews
* Lead operational improvement initiatives, including workflow redesign, technology adoption, and standardization across sites

**Regulatory Compliance and Quality**

* Ensure compliance with CMS Conditions of Participation, state licensure requirements, OSHA, HIPAA, and other applicable regulations
* Maintain continuous survey readiness; lead mock surveys, plans of correction, and responses to citations, complaints, and investigations
* Monitor quality measures, including Five-Star ratings, quality measures (QMs), PDPM accuracy, infection control, falls, pressure injuries, and rehospitalization rates
* Partner with clinical leadership and compliance to support QAPI programs and risk management

**Financial Management**

* Develop and manage budgets, forecasts, and financial targets for assigned facilities
* Monitor key indicators such as census, payer mix, case mix index, labor costs, agency utilization, and A/R
* Identify opportunities to improve margin through revenue optimization, expense control, and efficient staffing models
* Review monthly financials with facility leaders and implement corrective action plans as needed

**Workforce and Culture**

* Drive staff recruitment, retention, and engagement strategies, with particular attention to nursing and direct care staff
* Reduce reliance on agency staffing through sound scheduling practices, labor management, and workforce pipelines
* Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, and compassionate care

**Census and Relationship Development**

* Support admissions and business development efforts with hospitals, physician groups, ACOs, managed care organizations, and referral partners
* Strengthen community presence and reputation to support sustainable census growth
* Address resident, family, and stakeholder concerns promptly and professionally

### **Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business, nursing, or a related field
* 7+ years of progressive healthcare operations experience, including at least 3 years in a multi-facility or regional leadership role within long-term care or skilled nursing
* Active Nursing Home Administrator (NHA) license
* Strong working knowledge of CMS regulations, survey processes, PDPM, and Medicare/Medicaid reimbursement
* Demonstrated success managing P&Ls and improving financial and quality performance
* Proven ability to lead, develop, and hold accountable multi-disciplinary teams

**Preferred**

* Experience with value-based care, managed care contracts, or post-acute network participation
* Familiarity with EHR platforms such as PointClickCare or MatrixCare and workforce management systems
* Background in turnaround or acquisition integration of facilities

### **Working Conditions**

* Regional travel of approximately 90% to visit facilities
* Occasional evening, weekend, or on-call availability for emergencies, survey activity, or staffing crises
* Work in both office and clinical environments; may require vaccinations and health screenings per facility policy

Oakdale Seniors Alliance is an Equal Opportunity Employer

* Monitor key indicators such as census, payer mix, case mix index, labor costs, agency utilization, and A/R
* Identify opportunities to improve margin through revenue optimization, expense control, and efficient staffing models
* Review monthly financials with facility leaders and implement corrective action plans as needed

* Drive staff recruitment, retention, and engagement strategies, with particular attention to nursing and direct care staff
* Reduce reliance on agency staffing through sound scheduling practices, labor management, and workforce pipelines
* Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, and compassionate care

**Census and Relationship Development**

* Support admissions and business development efforts with hospitals, physician groups, ACOs, managed care organizations, and referral partners
* Strengthen community presence and reputation to support sustainable census growth
* Address resident, family, and stakeholder concerns promptly and professionally

* 7+ years of progressive healthcare operations experience, including at least 3 years in a multi-facility or regional leadership role within long-term care or skilled nursing
* Active Nursing Home Administrator (NHA) license
* Strong working knowledge of CMS regulations, survey processes, PDPM, and Medicare/Medicaid reimbursement
* Demonstrated success managing P&Ls and improving financial and quality performance
* Proven ability to lead, develop, and hold accountable multi-disciplinary teams

**Preferred**

* Experience with value-based care, managed care contracts, or post-acute network participation
* Familiarity with EHR platforms such as PointClickCare or MatrixCare and workforce management systems
* Background in turnaround or acquisition integration of facilities

### **Working Conditions**

* Regional travel of approximately 90% to visit facilities
* Occasional evening, weekend, or on-call availability for emergencies, survey activity, or staffing crises
* Work in both office and clinical environments; may require vaccinations and health screenings per facility policy

card.description:
**How to Apply**
----------------

A cover letter is required for consideration for this position and should be attached as the first page of your resume. The cover letter should address your specific interest in the position and outline skills and experience that directly relate to this position.

**Job Summary**
---------------

**Institutional Context and Operational Scale**

The University of Michigan serves the public through preeminence in creating, communicating, preserving, and applying knowledge, art, and academic values. As the university's largest academic unit, the College of Literature, Science, and the Arts offers more than 100 degree programs across more than 75 academic units and departments.

To support this expansive academic mission, LSA Facilities and Operations (LSA FO) manages a physical footprint encompassing approximately 2,000,000 square feet of building space. This comprises 27 primary buildings distributed across the Ann Arbor central campus, in addition to three outlying academic camps and several leased properties.

**Responsibilities\***
----------------------

**Scope of Responsibilities and Capital Oversight**

The Director of Facilities and Operations serves as a senior administrative leader and strategic advisor for LSA's physical environment, capital strategy, and operational services. Reporting to the Chief Financial and Operating Officer, the successful candidate would lead a 30-person team, including capital project managers, interior designers, facilities coordinators, building managers, movers, sustainability and lab safety team members, and administrative and financial support staff.

This role will lead LSA's transformational capital expansion, a multi-building project featuring new construction and major facility modernizations anticipated to exceed $1 billion in capital costs. The role oversees an annual departmental operating budget of $2 million and directs $20+ million in ongoing annual renovations, expansions, and modernizations. Concurrent responsibilities include:

* **Exemplary Customer Service:** Establish a proactive, service-oriented culture across all facilities operations, partnering with academic and administrative departments to evaluate evolving space and operational needs and implement continuous process improvements that optimize cost efficiency across college assets.
* **Capital Improvement and Renovation Oversight:** Direct all LSA facility renovation efforts, including capital improvement initiatives, specialized laboratory modernizations, interior design projects, and general building construction.
* **Research Infrastructure, Safety, and Support Operations:** Manage the start-up, commissioning, maintenance, and safe operations of core research facilities serving the broader university community, as well as provide administrative direction to the college moving and support services team.
* **Fiscal Stewardship and Sustainability:** Oversee the college utilities budget, lead energy conservation and sustainability initiatives, and manage commercial rental space procurement and lease administration.
* **University Partnerships:** Maintain active collaborative partnerships with university central units, including (but not limited to) the Provost's Office, Facilities & Operations (maintenance services, custodial services, and environmental health and safety), and the Department of Public Safety and Security (DPSS).
* **Emergency Management and Space Planning:** In partnership with DPSS and college academic and administrative leaders, lead LSA's emergency preparedness and crisis management response.
* **Strategic Alignment:** Advise executive leadership on strategic space allocation and long-range capital projects. Translate institutional vision into operational execution and ensure facilities strategies support broader college objectives.
* **Staff Leadership and Development:** Provide strategic leadership, mentorship, and professional development for LSA Facilities and Operations staff. Build a collaborative, inclusive, and accountable team culture that empowers employees, develops future leaders, recognizes individual contributions, and supports continued growth and excellence in service delivery.
* **Workplace Culture and Work-Life Balance:** Cultivate a positive, inclusive workplace environment that recognizes employee contributions and promotes a healthy balance between work and personal life.

**Required and Desired Qualifications**

Candidates for the Director of Facilities and Operations role are evaluated based on a combination of academic credentials, progressive managerial experience, and demonstrated technical competency in complex, decentralized institutional settings.

**Required Qualifications\***
-----------------------------

* A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Architecture, or Business (or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience),
* Ten (10) or more years of progressive responsibility, including direct management of a large department within a decentralized environment of comparable size and complexity.
* Demonstrated experience managing teams of ten (10) or more employees, alongside a record of long-term creative leadership of high-performing teams and comprehensive employee relations oversight.
* Demonstrated ability to build consensus and drive outcomes within a highly decentralized, shared-governance environment, representing the interests of academic leaders while coordinating closely with central institutional authorities.
* Proven success in initiating and executing organizational change initiatives across complex institutions serving diverse stakeholder interests.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large-scale capital projects and/or strategic and innovative facility initiatives aligned with institutional priorities.
* Proven ability to fulfill operational and financial stewardship targets in technical operational environments, alongside experience in emergency management and crisis response.

**Desired Qualifications\***
----------------------------

* A Master's degree or higher in architecture, engineering, business, or a related administrative field.
* Experience in public higher education and academic research environments.
* Five (5) or more years of experience managing technical operations, including capital construction management, space and master planning, core/recharge facility management, and technical contractor oversight.

**Modes of Work**
-----------------

Positions that are eligible for hybrid or mobile/remote work mode are at the discretion of the hiring department. Work agreements are reviewed annually at a minimum and are subject to change at any time, and for any reason, throughout the course of employment. Learn more about the work modes.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

The target salary range is $180,000 - $209,000. Compensation above this range may be considered for candidates with evidence of exceeding role expectations and driving measurable, enterprise impact, keeping internal equity in mind.

As one of the world's great liberal arts and sciences colleges, LSA pushes the boundaries of what is understood about the human experience and the natural world, and we foster the next generation of rigorous and empathetic thinkers, creators, and contributors to the state of Michigan, the nation, and the world.

 

To learn more about LSA's Mission, Vision and Values, please visit lsa.umich.edu/strategicvision.

 

**Mission Statement**

 

The mission of the University of Michigan is to serve the people of Michigan and the world through preeminence in creating, communicating, preserving and applying knowledge, art, and academic values, and in developing leaders and citizens who will challenge the present and enrich the future.

**Background Screening**
------------------------

The University of Michigan conducts background checks on all job candidates upon acceptance of a contingent offer and may use a third party administrator to conduct background checks. Background checks are performed in compliance with the Fair Credit Reporting Act.

**Application Deadline**
------------------------

Job openings are posted for a minimum of seven calendar days. The review and selection process may begin as early as the eighth day after posting. This opening may be removed from posting boards and filled any time after the minimum posting period has ended.

**U-M EEO Statement**
---------------------

The University of Michigan is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.

card.title: Director of Strategy and Operations
card.description:
ShipMonk isn't just a 3PL — we're the tech-powered growth partner for ecommerce brands, running 12+ owned fulfillment centers across the US, Canada, the UK, and Europe so our merchants can stress less and grow more.

We are seeking a hands-on Director to join our Strategy & Operations team and lead high-impact initiatives that improve how ShipMonk works across departments. Reporting to our Senior Director of Strategy and Operations, you will take our most important cross-functional problems from a blank page to a deployed solution: framing the problem, defining success, building the answer, and proving the results. Your first major initiative will be transforming how we schedule, staff, and manage our hourly warehouse workforce. 
 
What you'll do: 
 
Lead Cross-Department Initiatives

* Lead major initiatives that improve processes across departments, especially where work, systems, and ownership break down between teams.
* Frame ambiguous problems, define the outcome, and work backward into a solution that teams actually adopt.
* Lead on-site discovery with leaders and frontline teams to understand how work really gets done.

Transform Workforce Management

* Lead the redesign of how we schedule, staff, and manage our hourly warehouse teams, starting from what the business needs to achieve.
* Pilot solutions in one fulfillment center and scale what works across our network.
* Track the outcomes that matter, such as labor cost, staffing coverage, and retention.

Drive Continuous Improvement

* Help the whole organization work better, improving quality, speed, and the employee and merchant experience, not just cost.
* Spot recurring friction across teams, prioritize the biggest opportunities, and help teams adopt improvements that last.
* Make structured problem solving a habit at every level of the organization.

Strengthen Our Governance

* Support the organization as it matures how it sets priorities, makes decisions, and follows through on commitments.
* Partner with leaders to build governance practices that fit how each team works rather than imposing one structure.
* Bring clear analysis and decision materials to executive discussions.

Analyze, Build, and Drive Adoption

* Analyze productivity, capacity, cost to serve, and profitability, and build models that quantify trade-offs and turn decisions into action.
* Prototype tools and workflows hands-on with AI tools such as Claude, and partner with Engineering and Data to take them to production.
* Spend meaningful time on-site, leading change management so improvements stick rather than fade after launch.

What you'll need:

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, business, supply chain, or a related field
* 3-5 years of experience in operations transformation, strategy, or management consulting, including leading implementations from requirements through deployment and adoption
* A track record of solving ambiguous, cross-functional problems with structured, KPI-driven thinking
* Experience leading process redesign and change management across departments; Lean, Six Sigma, or similar experience is a plus
* Strong analytical and financial modeling skills; SQL or BI experience is a plus
* A hands-on ownership style: comfortable on the warehouse floor and personally driving execution and adoption
* Experience building with AI tools such as Claude to prototype solutions
* Exposure to fulfillment, distribution, or manufacturing operations; workforce management experience is a plus
* Strong executive communication and the ability to influence without direct authority
* Ability to travel 25–35%, with more time on-site during discovery and rollouts

**About ShipMonk**

ShipMonk isn't just a 3PL; we're a **growth partner for merchants**. We provide cutting-edge technology and a network of owned and operated fulfillment centers that empower high-growth ecommerce and DTC brands to stress less and grow more. With over 2,500 employees across five countries, we're on a mission to revolutionize fulfillment by providing everything from the fastest click-to-delivery and real-time inventory to custom solutions—all with a **merchant**-**first** mindset.

**Why ShipMonk?**

We believe in building for the long term, and our success is powered by five key differentiators that help us become true partners to our merchants.

* **Global Fulfillment Network:** Our 12+ owned and operated fulfillment centers span the US, Canada, the U.K., and Mainland Europe. We never outsource, ensuring quality and consistency. 
 + **Proprietary Technology:** We've eliminated the need for tribal knowledge with our AI-powered platform. It provides a real-time, unified view of inventory and orders, giving our merchants the control and visibility they need to succeed.
 + **Unrivaled Support:** We provide hands-on, "mom and pop" support with a global reach. Our dedicated teams are on-site at every fulfillment center, ready to jump into action.
 + **Transparent Pricing**: We believe in honest, long-term partnerships. Our all- inclusive pricing means predictable costs, with no hidden fees or surprises.
 + **Committed to the Future:** We invest over $10 million annually in research and development to ensure our technology and services continually evolve, helping merchants plant roots with a partner who is here to stay.

**Our Core Values**

Our values are the heart of our culture. We're looking for individuals who embody these principles every day.

* **Merchant-first:** We handle the logistics so our merchants can focus on what they do best—growing their business.
* **People make ShipMonk:** We believe in our team and invest in our people.
* **Own it:** We take ownership of our work, our mistakes, and our successes.
* **Get sh\*t done:** We're a fast-paced, high-growth company that values action and results.
* **Change the score:** We challenge the status quo, constantly innovating and improving.

 

ShipMonk is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

card.description:
**Role Summary**

The Director / Regional Manager of Operations provides strategic leadership and oversight for multiple dental practices across a defined region. This role is responsible for operational and financial performance, compliance, staff development, and practice growth. The position serves as a key liaison between executive leadership, dentist owners, and practice teams, supporting sustainable success through mentorship, systems alignment, and goal accountability.

**Essential Role Responsibilities**

The Regional Manager ensures all operational metrics, clinical standards, and financial goals are met while driving patient experience and practice expansion.

* Lead and oversee all operations for multiple dental locations (3-7 offices) within the assigned region.

* Develop, manage, and analyze budgets and P&L statements; initiate corrective action plans as needed.

* Hire, train, and retain high-performing talent in collaboration with HR and operating dentists.

* Onboard new team members and integrate them smoothly into business workflows.

* Train and coach practice leaders and staff to meet service, clinical, and business performance benchmarks.

* Collaborate with dentist owners and clinical leads to align strategic and patient care goals.

* Review KPIs and operational data to identify trends, troubleshoot issues, and develop action plans.

* Monitor and ensure adherence to internal policies, HIPAA, OSHA, and other compliance regulations.

* Design and lead scalable systems and initiatives across practices to standardize operations.

* Organize and present project plans, reports, and charters tailored to various audiences.

* Conduct regular site visits and performance reviews, support talent development and succession planning.

* Foster a culture of accountability, excellence, and continuous improvement.

* Stay current on dental industry trends, innovations, and competitive benchmarks.

* Maintain a strong presence in staff training, annual reviews, and performance conversations.

* Promote core values, patient-centered care, and professionalism in all operations.

**Role Qualification Guidelines**

***Required Role Qualifications***

* Bachelor's degree in business, healthcare administration, or related field.

* 6–8 years of multi-site operations management in dental or healthcare.

* Demonstrated ability to lead teams, manage KPIs, and drive profitability.

* Experience with strategic planning and implementation.

* Ability to travel to San Diego a minimum of once per month.

***Preferred Role Qualifications***

* Prior Director-level or senior operations leadership experience.

* DSO or private equity-backed group practice experience.

* Experience scaling practices and implementing enterprise-wide systems.

* Bilingual (English & Spanish) Strongly Preferred

***Required Licenses or Certifications***

* Valid driver's license and ability to travel across region.

* Compliance with OSHA/HIPAA certification requirements (training may be completed post-hire).

**Core Capabilities for Success**

The following are key attributes that are necessary for successful performance in the role. These capabilities are not required for the role and individuals may not exemplify all attributes of the capabilities outlined. However, the core capabilities should receive strong consideration when determining success or identifying a successful candidate for the role.

*Individuals with capabilities in contrast with the attributes below may achieve success in the role as performance in a role can have various external influencing factors. These factors should be considered when determining if an individual is an ideal fit for the role.*

***Knowledge and Skill***

* Advanced understanding of healthcare business operations and clinical compliance.

* Strong budgeting, performance analytics, and process development knowledge.

***Talent and Ability***

* Ability to lead, influence, and hold teams accountable across multiple locations.

* High-level critical thinking, decision-making, and communication skills.

***Personality Traits***

* Strategic, driven, and collaborative.

At Weiss-Aug we are driven by a commitment to excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement. Establishes and implements manufacturing policies, controls and procedures to further the company's interest in efficiently producing quality products. **Responsibilities**

* Management of manufacturing operations. Plans, schedules, organizes, and staffs manufacturing and manufacturing support functions. * Interprets company sales forecasts and shop orders and establishes accurate manufacturing plans to assure that our customers' requirements are met, that is, defect free product on time.
* Coordinates with Engineering, Sales and new product development engineering to maintain an awareness of current and future product plans.
* Develops and manages material control, manufacturing control, production scheduling, and planning systems to assure achievement of output schedules which will meet company sales requirements.
* Maintains material and parts inventories which are adequate to ensure the fulfillment of production schedules with minimum inventory expense.

* Works with tooling/engineering to investigate product quality and manufacturing problems and determine the most cost-efficient solutions.

* Is a member of the executive team and steering team which are responsible for the development of company policies and plans.

* Bachelor's degree Mechanical or Industrial Engineering.
* 8-10 years precision manufacturing experience including some experience in molding. (10 years in management role).

* Should have a working knowledge of computerized manufacturing systems.

* Medical, Dental and Vision
* 401 (k) with company match
* Holiday, Vacation and Sick Time
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Health Savings Accounts (HSA)
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* Cigna Wellness Incentive Program
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Short Term Disability
* Group Life and Accidental Insurance
* Sun Life – Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity Insurance
* Smoking Cessation Program
* Pet Insurance

### **Position:** ***Senior Director, Technology Operations***

 

Monogram Health is seeking a **Senior Director, Technology Operations** to own day‑to‑day operational leadership for enterprise technology operations, ensuring reliability, responsiveness, and a high-quality end‑user experience across Service Desk and Telecommunications platforms. This role provides focused operational ownership so enterprise delivery, enablement, and strategy can scale without diluting operational excellence.

 

#### **Responsibilities**

* Lead Service Desk and Telecommunications operations end‑to‑end.
* Own incident response, escalation paths, and operational readiness.
* Ensure consistent execution of onboarding/offboarding and access workflows.
* Accountable for CXone, RingCentral, IVR, dialers, and related platforms.
* Partner with engineering, vendors, and App Dev on stability and enhancements.
* Ensure agent and clinician experience is reliable and predictable.
* Own operational KPIs, SLAs, and support performance reporting.
* Identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Drive continuous improvement across support and telecom workflows.
* Directly lead managers and team leads across Service Desk and Telecom.
* Establish clear operating models, standards, and expectations.
* Serve as the single escalation and decision point for technology operations.

 

#### **Position Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or related field
* Minimum of seven (7) years of progressive experience in IT operations, service delivery, or technology infrastructure management, including minimum of four (4) years in a leadership role managing teams across Service Desk, Telecommunications, or similar operational functions.
* Demonstrated experience managing enterprise contact center and telephony platforms (e.g., CXone, RingCentral, IVR systems, dialers).
* Proven track record of owning and improving operational KPIs, SLAs, and support performance metrics.
* Experience with incident management, escalation frameworks, and operational readiness processes.
* Evidence of communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to operate at both strategic and tactical levels.
* Healthcare industry experience preferred, particularly within health plans or value‑based care environments.

 

#### **Compensation**

The base salary range for this role is $138,000 to $182,000 and reflects the range of experience and qualifications we may consider. Final compensation will be determined based on geographic location and job-related factors such as experience, skills, education, certifications, and internal compensation considerations. While a larger range is posted, most offers will typically fall within a narrower band based on these factors.

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for additional compensation, including bonus opportunities and a comprehensive benefits package.

 

#### **Benefits**

* **Comprehensive Benefits** - Medical, dental, and vision insurance, employee assistance program, employer-paid and voluntary life insurance, disability insurance, plus health and flexible spending accounts
* **Financial & Retirement Support** – Competitive compensation, 401k with employer match, and financial wellness resources
* **Time Off & Leave** – 20 PTO days, 7 paid holidays, and 1 floating day to make your own, and paid parental leave
* **Wellness & Growth** – Work life assistance resources, physical wellness perks, mental health support, employee referral program, and BenefitHub for employee discounts

 

#### **About Monogram Health**

Monogram Health is a leading multispecialty provider of in-home, evidence-based care for the most complex of patients who have multiple chronic conditions. Monogram health takes a comprehensive and personalized approach to a person’s health, treating not only a disease, but all of the chronic conditions that are present - such as diabetes, hypertension, chronic kidney disease, heart failure, depression, COPD, and other metabolic disorders.

Monogram Health employs a robust clinical team, leveraging specialists across multiple disciplines including nephrology, cardiology, endocrinology, pulmonology, behavioral health, and palliative care to diagnose and treat health issues; review and prescribe medication; provide guidance, education, and counselling on a patient’s healthcare options; as well as assist with daily needs such as access to food, eating healthy, transportation, financial assistance, and more. Monogram Health is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and on holidays, to support and treat patients in their home.

Monogram Health’s personalized and innovative treatment model is proven to dramatically improve patient outcomes and quality of life while reducing medical costs across the health care continuum.

Hayden Industrial is a rapidly scaling manufacturer of advanced industrial cooling and thermal management systems serving high-growth markets including data centers and infrastructure. This role is designed for a leader currently operating at—or ready to step into—the scope of a **$100M+ manufacturing site**. You will have broad authority to shape how the operation runs, scales, and performs.

You will be responsible for both **building the next-generation operating model** and **driving immediate performance improvements**. The mandate is clear: create a highly disciplined, scalable operation that can support significant growth while improving cost, delivery, and quality.

This is a **high-impact, high-visibility role** with the opportunity to build a best-in-class operation within a company that is investing heavily in its future.

 

**Key Responsibilities:**

 

* **Full Site Ownership**

o Own end-to end performance of the Tulsa site across safety, quality, delivery, and cost.

o Lead manufacturing, supply chain, and warehousing as a fully integrated operation.

o Establish clear accountability and performance standards across all functions.

o Act as the **site leader**, setting expectations, pace, and operating discipline.

* **Build + Scale the Operation**

o Design and implement the **operating system** required to support a $100M+scale operation.

o Build structure, process discipline, and management routines that drive consistency and predictability.

o Develop capacity strategies aligned with aggressive growth targets.

o Lead capital planning and deployment with a focus on throughput, efficiency, and ROI.

* **Drive Operational Performance**

o Improve on-time delivery, schedule adherence, and overall reliability.

o Increase throughput without proportional cost increases.

o Drive labor productivity and cost efficiency across the site.

o Identify and eliminate bottlenecks, constraints, and inefficiencies.

* **Supply Chain & Material Flow Excellence**

o Refine a **high-performing, production-aligned supply chain** at the plant level.

o Improve material availability, planning accuracy, and supplier coordination.

o Optimize inventory levels, accuracy, and working capital performance.

o Lead warehouse operations to ensure efficient flow from receiving through shipping.

* **Continuous Improvement with Measurable Impact**

o Lead Industrial Engineering and Continuous Improvement as core drivers of performance.

o Implement Lean principles focused on outcomes – not activity.

o Establish structured problem-solving and root cause discipline.

o Reduce cost of poor quality (COPQ), including scrap, rework, and inefficiencies.

* **Leadership & Team Transformation**

o Build and lead a high-performance leadership team across all functions.

o Upgrade talent where needed and develop strong internal capability.

o Create a culture of accountability, urgency, and execution.

o Develop succession plans and leadership depth to support continued scale.

* **Cross-Functional Integration**

o Partner with Engineering to ensure manufacturability and smooth new product introduction.

o Align closely with Supply Chain and Commercial teams to match production with demand.

o Ensure operational commitments are realistic, executable, and consistently delivered.

* **Safety & Quality Leadership**

o Champion a safety-first culture with zero tolerance for shortcuts.

o Drive improvements in quality, process capability, and consistency.

card.description:
**Position Summary**

LTI, a family-owned manufacturer of premium commercial foodservice equipment, is seeking a highly motivated, results-oriented Chief of Staff & Strategic Operations leader to partner directly with the CEO and executive leadership team in driving organizational performance, strategic initiatives, and operational excellence.

This individual will serve as a trusted advisor, strategic business partner, and execution leader responsible for translating company priorities into measurable results. The position will work across all functional areas to strengthen communication, improve business processes, accelerate decision-making, and ensure critical initiatives are completed on time and achieve their intended outcomes.

The successful candidate will be a hands-on impact player who thrives in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, demonstrates exceptional business judgment, takes ownership of results, and holds themselves and others accountable. This individual must balance strategic thinking with tactical execution and possess the leadership maturity to influence executives without relying on direct reporting authority.

As LTI continues to grow, this position will play an important role in scaling the organization, strengthening leadership effectiveness, and building the operational discipline necessary for long-term success.

**Major Responsibilities**

**1. Strategic Planning and Execution**

* Partner with the CEO and executive leadership team to develop, prioritize, and execute company-wide strategic objectives.
* Translate long-term business strategies into actionable plans with clearly defined milestones, responsibilities, deadlines, and performance measures.
* Lead and coordinate high-priority strategic initiatives that span multiple departments.
* Monitor progress against strategic objectives, identify obstacles, and drive corrective actions to ensure timely completion.
* Provide the CEO with objective assessments of organizational performance, emerging risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Ensure strategic initiatives remain aligned with company growth objectives, financial expectations, and organizational capabilities.

**2. Executive Leadership Support and Organizational Alignment**

* Serve as a strategic advisor and trusted business partner to the CEO.
* Function as a force multiplier by improving the effectiveness, focus, and execution capabilities of the executive leadership team.
* Coordinate cross-functional priorities involving Manufacturing, Engineering & Customer Support, Finance, Human Resources, and Business Development & Marketing.
* Facilitate executive leadership meetings, strategic planning sessions, and performance reviews to drive decisions and measurable outcomes.
* Establish clear accountability for decisions, action items, and commitments made by executive leadership.
* Identify organizational barriers, competing priorities, and communication gaps that negatively impact performance.
* Support the CEO in evaluating organizational effectiveness, leadership capacity, and future business needs.

**3. Operational Excellence and Continuous Improvement**

* Evaluate company-wide business processes, workflows, and operating practices to identify opportunities for greater efficiency and effectiveness.
* Partner with functional leaders to implement improvements that enhance productivity, quality, customer satisfaction, profitability, and organizational responsiveness.
* Lead cross-functional problem-solving efforts involving complex operational and business challenges.
* Promote disciplined execution, process standardization, and continuous improvement throughout the organization.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and coordinate resources to resolve issues that impact company performance.
* Support initiatives that improve the scalability of manufacturing operations and supporting business functions.
* Ensuring improvement initiatives produce measurable business results rather than simply generating additional activities or reporting.

**4. Performance Management and Accountability**

* Develop and maintain executive-level scorecards, key performance indicators (KPIs), and strategic initiative tracking systems.
* Establish consistent processes for monitoring progress toward company objectives and departmental commitments.
* Work with executive leaders to identify performance gaps and develop appropriate corrective action plans.
* Provide the CEO and leadership team with timely, accurate, and actionable information to support decision-making.
* Establish disciplined follow-up processes to ensure projects, initiatives, and executive commitments are completed within established deadlines.
* Promote a results-oriented culture that emphasizes ownership, urgency, transparency, and accountability.

**5. Strategic Projects and Change Management**

* Assume direct leadership of high-impact projects assigned by the CEO that require coordination across multiple functions.
* Develop project plans, define deliverables, establish timelines, and coordinate resources necessary for successful execution.
* Lead organizational change initiatives associated with business growth, process improvements, technology implementation, and operational transformation.
* Evaluate project risks, resolve implementation challenges, and communicate progress to executive leadership.
* Manage multiple competing priorities while maintaining attention to detail and consistently meeting deadlines.
* Support the evaluation and implementation of new business systems, technologies, and organizational capabilities.
* Ensure completed projects are successfully transitioned to the appropriate functional leaders for ongoing ownership.

**6. Financial and Business Performance**

* Partner with the CFO and functional executives to understand financial performance, operating results, and business trends.
* Support initiatives designed to improve profitability, productivity, cost management, and return on investment.
* Assist in evaluating business cases, capital investments, resource allocation, and strategic growth opportunities.
* Ensure major strategic initiatives include appropriate financial objectives and measurable business outcomes.
* Monitor performance against established financial and operational targets and help coordinate corrective actions when necessary.
* Maintain a company-wide perspective when evaluating decisions and recommending business priorities.

**7. Leadership Development and Organizational Effectiveness**

* Support the CEO in strengthening executive leadership effectiveness, collaboration, and organizational accountability.
* Identify opportunities to improve leadership processes, decision-making practices, and communication across departments.
* Partner with Human Resources and executive leadership to support succession planning, leadership development, and organizational readiness for growth.
* Encourage a culture of constructive debate, timely decisions, and consistent execution.
* Serve as a positive role model for LTI's core values of **Humble, Hungry, and Smart**.
* Build trust and credibility at all organizational levels, including executive leadership, office personnel, and manufacturing employees.
* Help preserve LTI's family-oriented culture while introducing the structure and discipline necessary to support continued growth.

**Qualifications**

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline required; MBA or advanced business degree preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive business leadership experience, including significant responsibility for operations, strategic planning, organizational performance, or cross-functional business initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience working directly with CEOs, presidents, business owners, or senior executive leadership teams.
* Experience in manufacturing, industrial products, or a similarly complex operational environment strongly preferred.
* Proven track record of leading strategic initiatives, managing complex projects, and delivering measurable business improvements.
* Experience in a growing, privately held, or family-owned business environment preferred.
* Demonstrated understanding of financial statements, business performance metrics, budgeting, and operational profitability.
* Experience implementing performance management systems, operational improvements, or organizational change initiatives.

**Leadership and Professional Competencies**

* **Strategic and Analytical Thinking:** Ability to understand the broader business environment, evaluate complex issues, and translate strategy into actionable priorities.
* **Execution and Results Orientation:** Strong sense of urgency, personal accountability, and demonstrated ability to deliver results within demanding deadlines.
* **Executive Presence and Influence:** Ability to communicate effectively with senior leaders, challenge assumptions constructively, and influence decisions without direct authority.
* **Business and Financial Acumen:** Strong understanding of how operational decisions affect financial performance, customer satisfaction, and long-term business success.
* **Cross-Functional Leadership:** Ability to coordinate multiple departments, build alignment, resolve conflicts, and drive shared objectives.
* **Problem-Solving and Decision-Making:** Ability to quickly assess challenges, identify root causes, evaluate alternatives, and implement practical solutions.
* **Project and Priority Management:** Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple high-priority initiatives simultaneously.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate effectively from the production floor to the executive office.
* **Adaptability and Resilience:** Comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where business priorities and demands may change.
* **Integrity and Confidentiality:** Demonstrated sound judgment, professionalism, discretion, and ability to handle sensitive business and personnel information.

**Personal Attributes and Cultural Fit**

The ideal candidate will demonstrate the following characteristics:

* A highly motivated self-starter who takes initiative and requires minimal supervision.
* An impact player who is energized by challenging assignments and opportunities to make a measurable difference.
* A strong work ethic with a willingness to roll up their sleeves and personally drive execution.
* A collaborative leader who values team success over individual recognition.
* A confident but humble professional who can respectfully challenge ideas and accept constructive feedback.
* A proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues rather than waiting for direction.
* A disciplined leader who establishes priorities, follows through on commitments, and consistently meets deadlines.
* A relationship builder who earns trust through credibility, transparency, and demonstrated results.
* A leader who embraces the values and personal accountability expected within a family-owned business.

**Organizational Authority and Scope**

The Chief of Staff & Strategic Operations will report directly to the CEO and work collaboratively with all members of the executive leadership team.

The position will initially operate primarily through cross-functional leadership, executive influence, and authority delegated by the CEO rather than through direct supervision of existing functional departments.

Functional executives will retain accountability for their respective departments, while the Chief of Staff & Strategic Operations will help coordinate company-wide initiatives, facilitate decision-making, and ensure execution of strategic priorities.

The position may assume additional operational responsibilities and direct reports as the organization grows and business needs evolve.

**Measures of Success**

Success in this position will be evaluated through demonstrated improvements in:

* Timely completion of strategic initiatives and executive priorities.
* Organizational alignment and accountability across functional departments.
* Operational efficiency, productivity, and business process effectiveness.
* Achievement of established company-wide performance objectives.
* Executive leadership effectiveness and decision-making.
* Successful implementation of high-impact business projects.
* Financial and operational improvements resulting from strategic initiatives.
* Organizational readiness to support continued growth.

**Overall Expectation:** The Chief of Staff & Strategic Operations must consistently demonstrate an ability to convert business priorities into completed actions, measurable improvements, and sustainable organizational results.

card.description:
**Job Summary**

The Director of Operations leads business operations and operations management, turning strategic plans into clear priorities and effective execution. This role guides senior leadership and executive-level teams, oversees budgets and financial performance, and advances operational excellence through data-driven decisions and process improvement. The Director also supports business development management and leads change across the organization.

**Responsibilities**

* Set strategic direction for operations and align programs and projects with business priorities.
* Lead executive-level team management, supervise managers, and communicate plans and performance clearly with executives.
* Direct budget management, forecasting, financial management, and profit and loss (P&L) analysis; use operational analysis to guide decisions.
* Identify and deliver process improvement and operational excellence initiatives, including large-scale organizational change management.
* Manage business development efforts and coordinate cross-functional programs to strengthen business performance.
* Your impact: By connecting operational analysis with practical process improvements, you help teams work more effectively and support better outcomes for the business and its customers.

**Qualifications**

* 4+ Years of demonstrated leadership, management, and supervising experience in business management, business operations, or operations management.
* Experience in strategic management, strategic planning, project management, program management, and change management.
* Experience managing budgets and financial performance, including executive-level budget management, budgeting, forecasting, and P&L analysis.
* Ability to make data-driven decisions and lead operational analysis and process improvement.
* Strong verbal communication with executives and experience guiding senior leadership or executive-level teams.
* Experience in business development and operational excellence initiatives is preferred.

Pay: Up to $65,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Ogden, UT 84401
